name: Rikka
source:
The club's founder and leader. An excitable, energetic girl who adores making new friends, she quickly adopts all of the introverts around her.

Rikka is often childish, naive, and too sweet for her own good, so others tend to be overly protective of her... but is that a good thing?

She's also a top reviewer on Rotten Potatoes.

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/doce-fim]official profile[/url]]
